sections.text: Customer C-52007. Order SO-88412. Product HL-3310.
sections.title: Warranty claim: Pulse Wireless Headphones

sections.text: About a month after I bought them, the left ear cup of my Pulse Wireless Headphones stopped producing any sound. The right side still works, and the headphones still pair and charge normally. I tried a reset and a second phone; the left side stays silent either way.
sections.title: The defect

sections.text: I would like a replacement pair. If no replacement is available, please refund the price I paid, $89.99.
sections.title: What I am asking for

sections.text:
I already reported this to customer service on 3 October 2026:

Hello, the left side of my Pulse headphones has gone completely silent after four weeks. Is this covered by the warranty, and should I send them in or bring them to a store?

I have not received a reply yet, so I am filing this claim.
